title: Mathematics for Machine Learning
summary: Only the maths you need: functions, vectors and matrices, statistics, probability, derivatives and gradient descent, all shown with small runnable examples.
outcomes: Read and use functions, lines, exponents and logarithms
Understand vectors, matrices and the dot product behind every model
Summarise data with mean, median, variance and standard deviation
Use probability, the normal distribution, correlation and covariance
Explain derivatives and gradients, and run gradient descent by hand
